branch.via: workflow_dispatch input; for issue-comment dispatch, a branch named in the issue body governs if it names one

issue_number.via: workflow_dispatch input, or the issue the trigger comment is posted on

routes.producer_class: gemini-build-arm — google-github-actions/run-gemini-cli (model gemini-3.5-flash-lite) in a full checkout, running under the Termux Fleet Swarm App token (SEC-03 mint-before-checkout); produces a branch and a PR against master, or an already-exists comment. Not the gemini-dispatch invoke router (text-only).
routes.receipt: Pre-builder receipt comment on the build issue (marker <!-- build-dispatch-receipt:v1 -->) carrying {route · run_id · run_url · branch · fired_by · started_at · heartbeat_deadline = run start + 75 min}; the outcome lands as the builder's PR against master or an already-exists comment on the issue; a failed run posts a run-failed comment on the issue.

issue_body.via: the filing itself; parsed by scripts/dispatch/project_task.py against the exact ### section contract (Entry · Task / spec · Scope · Done-evidence · Target repo)

routes.producer_class: intake-router — validates the filing and posts the routing receipt; selection and execution happen in the fleet's existing claim/dispatch machinery (this route queues, it does not itself build).
routes.receipt: Routing receipt comment on the issue plus the `dispatch-queued` label on valid intake; an intake diagnosis comment plus the `intake-incomplete` label on malformed intake.

trigger.keying: the issue carries the `project-task` label or its title starts with `[task]`

admission_handoff.via: the `issue-admission` artifact of the triggering swarm-admission run

issue_body.via: fetched from the admitted issue; validated by scripts/dispatch/project_task.py

routes.producer_class: admission-follower queueing route — validates an admitted game-development filing against the project-task contract and queues it; provider selection and execution remain in the existing claim/dispatch machinery.
routes.receipt: Queueing comment on the issue (the routing receipt generated by scripts/dispatch/project_task.py) plus the `game-development` and `dispatch-queued` labels on valid intake; an intake diagnosis comment plus the `intake-incomplete` label when the contract fails.

trigger.condition: upstream run conclusion is success and the issue-admission handoff artifact selects the filing (matched = true, template = game-development-task.yml, decision = admitted)

action.via: allowlisted provider:action pair (OPERATOR_COMMAND_ACTIONS + .github/agentic/provider-command-library.json, read from the default branch)

confirm_branch_write.via: must be true for actions that can commit or create a stacked PR

gitlab_sha.via: required for branch-changing provider actions (RECON INTEL lease check)

head_sha.via: must equal the PR's current head SHA (stale-SHA dispatches fail closed)

policy_version.via: required shape recon-intel-v<N> for branch-changing provider actions

pr_number.via: workflow_dispatch input or repository_dispatch client_payload; the PR must be open

provider.via: one of coderabbit | qodo | devin (workflow_dispatch choice input)

routes.producer_class: provider-command operator — executes one explicit, allowlisted provider operation (coderabbit / qodo / devin) on an open PR; the dispatch actor must be listed in OPERATOR_EXECUTOR_LOGINS; the command library is read from the trusted default branch, never a PR head.
routes.receipt: Dispatch receipt stamped on the PR — the provider control comment is patched or a receipt comment is posted (marker <!-- operator-provider-command:v1 -->) carrying {head_sha · provider · action · effect · execution mode} — and a dispatch stamp is fanned out to the scoring planes via dispatch-stamp-fanout.yml.

rule: A route is claimable only if it is registered here. Register a new route in the same PR that adds its workflow; every row's facts are read from the workflow of record.
